findings.summary: The Qwen3 Embedding 4B Metal-backed local sidecar closed the embedding connection during synthetic durability probes and the shard response export.
findings.interpretation: Runtime instability only; do not score as model quality.

findings.summary: CPU-only Qwen3 Embedding 4B with 4096 context passed 16, 128, 512, and 700 token synthetic embedding probes with 2560-dimensional vectors.
findings.interpretation: Usable for overnight/local methodology refinement, but not an interactive default.

findings.summary: The CPU-only full shard response export was stopped after making slow progress; only the previously completed BM25, full-hybrid, and query-expanded response arms were preserved.
findings.interpretation: Run CPU-only 4B as an overnight method lane or reduce to a canary before committing full-shard time.

findings.summary: The same shell could not see Gemini, NVIDIA, or Voyage credentials during provider preflight.
findings.interpretation: Provider challenger lanes are method-ready but cannot run until credentials are passed via environment variables or private key files outside the repository.

nextRecommendedLanes: Use direct Gemini Embedding 2 and NVIDIA Nemotron provider arms when credentials are visible.
Keep Voyage as the cloud default baseline when quota is available.
Use CPU-only Qwen3 Embedding 4B only for overnight local experiments or small canaries.
Do not merge CPU-only 4B results into the accepted 0.6B local-full aggregate without separate lane labeling.
